name: PT Tembaga Mulia Semanan Tbk
summary: PT Tembaga Mulia Semanan Tbk manufactures, sells, and exports copper and aluminum rods and wires in Indonesia and internationally. It operates through Copper Rod and Wire, and Aluminum Rod segments. The Copper Rod and Wire segment produces copper rods and various sizes of copper wires. The Aluminum Rod segment produces EC grade rod, alloy rod, and TAL rod. PT Tembaga Mulia Semanan Tbk was incorporated in 1977 and is based in Jakarta Barat, Indonesia.
